title: The Contract Before the Model
subtitle: Freeze what the agent may know, what it must call, and how a wrong answer fails
description: Turn an in-car request into an explicit tool contract and a deterministic evaluation. Separate changing world facts from model behavior, hard constraints from soft preferences, and extraction errors from ranking errors before generating a single training example.
